messages.text: Good afternoon, I was wondering if you could tell me what allergens are in the almond croissant? I am very sensitive, so I just wanted to make sure I knew what was in it.
The almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg.
Could you please tell me what allergens are in the banana bread? I am very sensitive, so I just want to be absolutely sure about the ingredients.
The banana bread contains wheat and egg.
